note: Prior enforcement overstated full RFC5036 section 3.4.4.1. The two tagged tests correctly prove Label Mapping count 5 above maximum 4 yields advisory Loop Detected with exact offending reference, no callback and Operational state, while count 4 is applied with timeout-only wire silence. But the RFC also covers Label Request containing Hop Count; Session.processMessages treats MsgTypeLabelRequest as unhandled and never checks its hop count or sends Loop Detected. Both tests send Mapping, leaving that receive case untested. Renewed producer-halt records do not close the semantic gap.
